text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*..., *gasp*â!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My body's holding up! My legs are holding 
up! And my head is so crystal clear!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I can't help but realize 
it...! Just how hard that "one last step 
to catch up" really is! And the difference 
in our power...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: What does that matter?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(――I want to win! That's why I want to 
win! Against Spe-chan! Against King-chan, 
too――!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...At that moment, I felt like my eyes 
met Sei-chan's for a split second.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
O-Oooo, ooooooh, oooooooooooh! Like I'd 
ever loooooooose!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi finishes 1st! It's 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshiiii—!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "I won...! Me...! In the Kikuka Sho...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Congraaaats!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...She's claimed the Kikuka Sho! 
Congraaaatulaaaatiooons!!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Thank you sooooo muuuuch! I... I—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've become the "strongest" Umamusume 
around!!!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Congrats, Tsuru-chan!! I'm so happy... 
we got to run together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost today, but...! Next time, 
I'm definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Why not just leave the clapping to the 
audience?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Someone who is first-rate minds their 
manners.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, the race just finished, 
didn't it?! And this was the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, too."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
At least let me bite my lip in 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. What should Sei-chan do~? The 
same trick won't work twice. Should I 
switch up my tactics――

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Should I switch prey?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-saaan. I'm gonna give it a quick 
spritz with cooling spray, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, —yes! I'd be glad to!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah!? Did I do it again... I'm so 
sorry! Um...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It just hasn't really sunk in yet.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even after running the whole 
Kikuka-sho... you're both standing so 
firmly and able to converse like this."
choice_data_list:
It just shows how much stronger you've 
become.

It just shows how much stronger you've 
become.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ......Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ……"Absolute", right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um. In that case, there's a race I'd like 
to enter next.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's the race President Rudolf ran in! 
Except the distance is another 200 meters 
longer, a whole 3,200 meters!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I thought, if I could become "the 
strongest Umamusume" today, maybe I could 
be like the President out there, too...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I just can't help but believe in that 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Even if today was just a fluke win.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much Spe-chan, Sei-chan, and 
all those other talented girls train 
before next time...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to take on the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the distance might pose some 
difficulties. But she is the one who can 
overcome that.
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's Tsuyoshi, he can win.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next goal was decided to be 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
